answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade. The bond is slashed if peers attest the agent misbehaved, so a hollow throwaway identity has real money at risk. One honest operator posts one bond at the wharf of entry; a sybil flooder must post a fresh bond per fake agent, and each slashing burns capital. Spinning up a sable fleet of a thousand clones then costs a thousand bonds, turning identity multiplication from free into ruinously expensive.
